The lighting appears flat, and the textures suggest a mix of glossy paper and digital illustration styles.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Several comic books appear to merge into one another without clear physical boundaries. Edges bleed together, and it is unclear where one cover ends and another begins, violating physical object separation.

The stacking physics appear inconsistent. Some comics seem to float or intersect at impossible angles. The structural integrity of the pile is questionable, with some items appearing to melt into the background or each other.

The texture lacks the fine detail of real paper grain or ink dot patterns. It has a smooth, painted quality that is uniform across different surfaces, lacking the micro-variation expected in a photograph of printed materials.
